title: pool check's unstated-names warning misses an invented identifier behind an inline flag, a group or a quantifier
goal: identifier_of in _tools/bench_pool.py judges the identifier inside a check alternative written as (?i)Name, (Name|Other) or Name(?:s)?, so pool check warns of an invented name in those forms as it does of the bare one. No committed row hits it on 2026-10-12. Found by the SP-j2jn5ue4 review.

run: import sys,json;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import bench_pool as b;R=b.read_csv(b.PUBLIC_FILE);r=next(x for x in R if x["kind"]=="fact" and x["source"].startswith("lookup_eval.csv:"));r["checks"]=json.dumps(["(?i)Invoke-ZzqxInventedDrift"]);sys.exit(0 if b.unstated_names([r]) else 1)
